content: NON – DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT This Non disclosure Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of DD/MM/2025, by and between: Name: M/s. TYN Ecosystem Pvt Ltd Address: Block 3, Flat No. 2K, Radiance Ivy Terrace Apts, OMR, Egattur, Rajiv Gandhi Salai, Navalur, Chinglepet, TN 603103 IN ("Referrer") AND Name: [Product Company Name] Address: [Product Company Address] ("Solution provider") NOW, THIS AGREEMENT SHALL WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:
Term: This Agreement shall remain in force until 31/12/2027 subject to periodical renewals with mutual consent between the parties in writing.

Confidentiality: Both parties agree to maintain confidentiality regarding any proprietary or confidential information shared under this Agreement. The obligations of confidentiality will survive the termination of this Agreement. All confidential information, and all material items delivered by the referrer to the Solution Provider, remain the property of the referrer and no license or other rights in the confidential information are granted to the Solution Provider by this Agreement or by the act of disclosure. Similarly, the confidential information disclosed by the solution provider shall remain confidential & property of the solution provider in accordance with the terms of the agreement.

Limitation of liability: In no event shall the referrer or any of its directors, officers, employees, or agents be liable for any consequential, indirect, direct, exemplary, special punitive, or incidental damages, arising from or relating to this agreement and any agreement entered between Solution Provider and any party introduced by the referrer.

Termination: Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing 30 days written notice to the other party. Notwithstanding anything contained in this Agreement, both parties shall maintain the confidentiality and security of confidential information even after the Solution Provider’s service with the referrer ends and continues for a period of two (2) years from the date of the last disclosure by the Company.

General: This Agreement contains the entire agreement between the parties, and supersedes any prior written or oral agreements between them concerning the subject matter contained herein. If any provision of this Agreement shall be held invalid or unenforceable by a court of competent jurisdiction, the remaining provisions hereof shall continue to be fully effective.

Governing Law / Jurisdiction / Dispute Resolution: This Agreement shall be governed by Indian laws. In case of disputes, either Party shall approach the competent courts at Chennai, which shall have the sole and exclusive jurisdiction to determine the disputes. IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have executed this Agreement on the day and the year hereinabove first written. For and on behalf of: For and on behalf of: [Solution Provider Name] TYN Ecosystem Pvt. Ltd.
